mintAuthority.summary: Base is the sole native UTY issuance chain: the UUPS ERC-7540 vault accepts Base USDC through collateralized deposit()/mint() and has a mutable maxTotalAssets cap. The Base owner is a 3-of-4 Safe with no observed modules or guard; any of the three Base MANAGER_ROLE members can also raise the cap without delay. Avalanche and Katana are LayerZero OFT bridge representations and their bridge administration is assessed under Bridge Risk.

review.evidence: Base is the sole native UTY issuance deployment: the verified Base UUPS vault accepts Base USDC through collateralized deposit()/mint(), exposes maxDeposit()/maxMint(), and has a mutable maxTotalAssets cap. At Base block 50066315 the Base owner was Safe 0xb237eb3c71a0f351bd121b0c467248473fbc2cca, a 3-of-4 Safe with no observed modules or guard; the Safe can replace Base mint logic without a timelock, and the three Base MANAGER_ROLE members can independently call setMaxTotalAssets(). Avalanche and Katana use the same-address deployments only as LayerZero mint/burn OFT representations against the Base ShareOFTAdapter lockbox, so their bridge owner, peer, and upgrade powers are excluded from native Mint Authority and recorded under Bridge Risk. Economic-posture evidence remains unchanged: maxTotalAssets is currently uint256 max, reconciliation is continuous through Accountable telemetry, and supervision is attestation-only.
